hello_body: hexframe lays out a system as a hierarchy of tiles, so AI can work along its intent.
dev_ui_tokens_body: Every colour token in the theme, with its foreground on it when it has one. Switch the theme to see the other half.
ui_error_body: This could not be loaded. Try again; if it keeps failing, send us the request id.
ui_forbidden_body: This belongs to someone who hasn't shared it with you.
dev_ui_description: Every theme token, then every component of ui/ in each of its states. Switch the theme and the language to see the rest.
dev_ui_state_menu: Icons, a disabled entry, a separator, a destructive entry
dev_ui_state_rows_sortable: Rows, sortable by title and children
dev_ui_state_with_retry: With a retry and a request id
dev_ui_form_hint: Leave the title empty, or write more than {limit} characters, then save
dev_ui_form_title_description: What the tile is, in a few words.
dev_ui_form_preview_description: At most {limit} characters: what a reader needs to decide whether to open it.
dev_ui_form_preview_too_long: A preview holds at most {limit} characters.
dev_ui_sample_delete_description: The tile and everything below it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
dev_ui_sample_publish_description: Anyone with the link will be able to read it and everything below it.
dev_ui_sample_tile_preview: How I lead a team, and what I learned doing it.
dev_ui_sample_tile_body: Six children say what it does; its context says what it is.
dev_ui_sample_page_description: Everything I maintain, one tile at a time.
dev_ui_sample_error_message: This tile could not be loaded.
dev_ui_sample_forbidden_message: This tile is private. Ask its owner to share it with you.
dev_ui_empty_description: A tile is one thing you maintain. Start with the first.
dev_ui_toast_info_message: Someone else is editing this tile.
dev_ui_toast_warning_message: You are offline; changes will be saved later.
dev_ui_toast_error_message: The tile could not be saved.
dev_hex_description: The hex canvas on a fixture System. Click a tile to expand or collapse it, click the center to show its context, double-click a tile or press Shift+Enter on it to center it. The view lives in the URL.
conversation_empty_description: Ask the assistant to build or change your system, and what you do on the canvas shows up here too.
conversation_message_placeholder: Ask the assistant to build or change your system
error_forbidden: This belongs to someone who hasn't shared it with you.
error_not_found: This doesn't exist, or no longer does.
error_conflict: This changed in the meantime. Reload, then try again.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again; if it keeps failing, send us the request id.
error_dev_not_found: This dev record doesn't exist. (The table's entry for DevNotFound, in every scope.)
dev_errors_description: Every channel a failure can take, provoked through the server function helper. Where it shows depends on its kind, and on whether the call was a read or a write; never on the page.
dev_errors_read_description: Unauthenticated redirects to sign-in. Forbidden shows the Forbidden state; any other failure shows the error state, with a retry and the request id.
dev_errors_frame_title: A read that frames every page
dev_errors_frame_description: Unauthenticated redirects to sign-in. Any other failure is reported in the browser's console, and nothing shows on screen.
dev_errors_write_description: Unauthenticated redirects to sign-in. Any other failure shows one toast.
dev_errors_form_description: Leave the title empty for Invalid, shown on the field. Type “taken” for a Conflict, shown in a toast. Anything else saves.
